outcome: Neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection (antigen and PCR tests)
cohort: The study analyzed 42 neonates born to women with positive SARS-CoV-2 antigen tests between December 2020 and February 2021 in a single infective obstetric unit.
finding: Most babies born to SARS-CoV-2-positive mothers are not infected by the virus post-birth, indicating a low risk of perinatal mother-to-child transmission.
